$description: SLO/Error Budget policy for autonomy governance. Defines failure thresholds, window sizes, and enforcement actions.

windows.runWindowDescription: Number of recent runs to evaluate for budget calculation
windows.timeWindowDescription: Maximum age of records to include in evaluation window

budgetTargets.criticalDescription: Maximum critical failures before budget exhausted (hard block)
budgetTargets.warnDescription: Maximum warning-level failures before budget burning
budgetTargets.okMinSuccessRateDescription: Minimum success rate (%) to maintain OK status

low.description: Operational failures with lower security impact

burning.description: Budget degrading - increased monitoring, optional canary demotion

exhausted.description: Budget exhausted - autonomy blocked until recovery

enforcement.blockOnExhaustedDescription: Hard-block all autonomy applies when budget exhausted

recovery.autoRecoverDescription: Budget auto-recovers as failed records age out of window
